name: TOTP Recovery Code Sign-In Handler
summary: Resolves the durable identity from a password-issued MFA challenge, validates one recovery code through the real MFA manager, and consumes the challenge only after the recovery proof succeeds.

sourceReferences.note: Rejects missing, mismatched, expired or TOTP-ineligible MFA challenges before recovery-code evaluation; accepted proof invokes AppUserMfaManager as step-up and then consumes the MFA challenge.
